always_on: word-by-word captions synced to the voice
cuts snapped to the music beat
every picture checked for wrong show / duplicates / text / photos before use
designed cover picked by the quality checker
music from the licensed library, ducked under the voice
cannot_do_yet: any request not listed here: ask anyway - it is logged as a feature request for the developers

effects.blue_tint: Cold blue grade for the whole scene (sad, lonely, mystery).
effects.bw: Black-and-white grade for the whole scene (flashback, death, past).
effects.flash: White flash as the scene starts.
effects.freeze: Freeze-frame record-scratch: the first 0.7 s holds still, desaturated, with a white flash and a slow push-in (for 'wait... what?' moments).
effects.glitch: Glitch hit (RGB split + slices) as the scene starts, whatever the global transition.
effects.impact_text: Huge slam-in text over the scene's first ~1.4 s (e.g. 'EXPOSED', 'NOBODY NOTICED'). Uses 'text', else the scene headline. Params: text, color.
effects.letterbox: Cinematic black bars for the whole scene (epic / backstory moments).
effects.rank_badge: Big rank number badge in the top corner for the whole scene (e.g. '#3'). Params: text.
effects.red_tint: Blood-red danger grade for the whole scene (villain, threat, horror).
effects.shake: Strong camera shake as the scene starts.
effects.slow_zoom: Strong continuous push-in on every picture of the scene (tension).
effects.versus: Split screen: the scene's first two pictures stacked top/bottom with a VS badge (for Who Would Win / comparisons). Needs 2+ pictures in the scene.
effects.zoom_punch: Hard zoom punch as the scene starts.

how_to_request: submit_plan / remake_reel take 'style' (JSON object of Style Spec keys) and 'edits' (JSON object: role -> list of effects). Roles: hook, fact, twist, theory, what_if, rank, outro, all.
